title: Every battle in history, mapped
excerpt: Wikidata knows of 20,202 battles. I mapped the 13,712 with a place and a date, from 3001 BCE to 2026, to find the most fought-over places on Earth, follow the centre of war century by century, and see how much the famous map is really a map of who wrote things down.
seo_description: 13,712 battles mapped from Wikidata, 3001 BCE to 2026: the most fought-over places, the centre of war, and the bias in the record.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Every battle in history' in black and red on pale paper, beside a map of Europe, North Africa and the Middle East covered in small dots coloured by era, densest in western Europe and the Levant. Text: 13,712 battles with a place and a date, 3001 BCE to 2026; most fought-over: Flanders, 369 battles; Europe has 51% of battles and 7% of the land.
